name: First Blood
description: You are a new recruit at Wardens' Rest, the Wardens' fort on the West Downs. The Warden who keeps the top of the Hushline Stair is owed a month's pay, and Sergeant Dole will send it south today with whichever recruit can fight.
notes: The warrior's tutorial (docs/FIGHTING_STYLE_STARTS.md 3.1), begun by core:opening/warrior, made plainer for triage 51-52 and the fourth playtest: one goal (be fit to carry the pay south), told by Dole at once; four stages (the yard, the ring, the ditch, the report), the boar on the down cut; every change of stage said out loud by Dole or Tam as it happens, and each journal entry opens on why. Hollin is handed over after the first lesson (the_yard's on_complete, tethered across the yard: `hollin_tether`) and ridden to the ditch (`mount`, Rider). The yard's pells are Pell bodies (`prop:pell`, the objectives' `against`, so the marker points at them); the ring's bout is the_ring's `spar` (Sparring); the ditch's two bandits are the Wynstead Ditch Camp's own by day, and QuestFoes stands them by night. Every lesson is an `act` objective (EventBus.act_done). Dole's and Tam's lines are in their dialogues and hold them in the yard (their npc defs' holds).

spots.name: tam_ditch
spots.notes: the verge above the ditch on the fort's side, where Tam stops and does not come down

spots.name: hollin_tether
spots.notes: the yard's far side from the pells, where Dole has Hollin tied for you after the first lesson

stages.journal:
Sergeant Dole is waiting to tell you what today is for, and why you are here.

He is standing at the end of the row of pells in the Wardens' drill yard, a few paces from you. Go and speak to him.

objectives.text: Speak to Sergeant Dole in the drill yard {key:interact}

stages.journal:
Sergeant Dole needs a recruit to ride the Stair Head's pay south today, and it will be whoever can fight. He starts you on the pells.

Go to the three pells in the drill yard, the wooden posts in a row. Strike them: three light blows, then two heavy blows, then lock on to one.

How: the light blow is quick. The heavy blow is held back and let go; it breaks a guard, and it costs more of your stamina, the bar that empties as you fight. Lock on, and your eyes stay on one enemy, because a bandit does not stand still to be looked at.

objectives.text: Strike a pell with light blows {key:attack_light}

say: Twice is a guess. Three is a habit. Now the heavy. Hold it back, and let it go.

objectives.text: Strike a pell with heavy blows: hold {key:attack_heavy}, then let go

say: You swung twice. The bandit swings once and means it. Mean it.
That one's yours now. Nobody else's. Keep your eyes on what's yours.
Good. — Hollin's yours from today, the Wardens' cob; she's tied across the yard. Whoever carries the pay rides her. Now do it with somebody hitting back. Into the ring.

stages.journal:
The pells don't hit back. Bandits do, so Dole wants to see you take a blow before he sends you anywhere.

Go to the roped ring beside the pells and tell him you are ready. He fights you with a blunt blade and says each blow before it comes. Take two blows on your shield, parry one, and roll through two.

How: your shield is your roof: hold it up and a blow stops on it. Raise it just as the blow lands and the blade is turned aside (a parry), and the man behind it is open for a moment. A roll takes you out of a blow you cannot stop. If he knocks you down he helps you up and tells you the one thing you did wrong.

Dole has given you Hollin, the Wardens' cob. She is tied across the yard.

tips: Shield up. Up. That is your roof. Nobody fights in the rain without a roof.
Late. You raised it when the blow had come. Raise it as it comes.
You stood there. When it's coming and you can't stop it, don't be there.
spar.again: Again. Slower, if you like. I don't.

objectives.text: Tell Sergeant Dole you are ready, in the ring
Take two of his blows on your shield: hold {key:block}
Parry one: raise the shield {key:block} just as the blow lands
Roll through two of his swings {key:dodge}

say: Enough. You'll bruise; that's how you'll know it went in. Now something that means it. Two bandits in the Wynstead ditch, south-east, on the road the pay goes by. Ride Hollin down. Take Tam. Tam! Go on ahead.

stages.journal:
Dole has seen you take a blow; now the road the pay goes south by must be cleared of the two bandits dug in at the Wynstead ditch.

He wants to see you win a fight that means it. They have dug in to a dry ditch on the Wynstead road and taken the milestone off the verge for a table.

Get up on Hollin and ride to the Wynstead ditch camp, a long bowshot south-east of the fort past the old sheepwash. Put down the two bandits in it. Tam Hobb, the other recruit, has gone ahead and waits on the verge.

How: take their first rush on the shield. When one swings, parry, and strike while he is open (a riposte). A heavy blow staggers the other.

objectives.text: Get up on Hollin {key:interact}, across the yard
Put down the two bandits in the Wynstead ditch
Parry a bandit, then strike {key:attack_light} while he is open
Stagger a bandit with a heavy blow

say: They're down. They're down. — Go and tell the Sergeant the road's clear. I'll... I'll be along.

stages.journal:
The ditch is quiet and the road is clear. Dole said he would send the pay with whoever could fight, and you have.

Ride back to the fort and tell Sergeant Dole the road is clear.

Tam did not come down off the verge the whole fight, and he knows you saw. He is still up there, if you want a word.

objectives.text: Tell Sergeant Dole at the fort the road is clear

say: South, then. The fingerposts know the way. Don't stop to be admired.

name: The Relief
description: Sergeant Dole has given you the Stair Head's month's pay and the Roll's new page. Ride them south on Hollin to the Warden who keeps the top of the Hushline Stair.
notes: The warrior's tie-in (docs/FIGHTING_STYLE_STARTS.md 3.1, 3.1a): south from Wardens' Rest by Merrowby, Wynstead and Ashwell, a Hearthstone halfway at the Wellspring, the road threat at the Glass Bridge (two ash-wights come up from under the arch onto the road where Tam waits, stood by QuestFoes), and the Stair Head, where Tam goes down the stair and the Naming begins at down_the_stair. Hollin was given in the tutorial's first stage, so the first objective is the ride.

spots.name: tam_glass_bridge
spots.notes: the road's west end of the bridge, the Choir's side, looking back across it

stages.journal:
The Warden at the Stair Head is a month short of her pay, and you carry it, with the Roll's new page.

Dole says to touch a Hearthstone on the way: if the road kills you, you wake at the last stone you touched.

Ride Hollin south by Merrowby, Wynstead and Ashwell to the Wellspring, a little off the road past Ashwell, and put your hand on its Hearthstone. The fingerposts name each place.

Tam has gone ahead on the carrier's cart and will meet you at the Glass Bridge, past Pilgrim's Ash. Whistle for Hollin if you leave her behind.

objectives.text: Put your hand on the Wellspring's Hearthstone

on_complete.notify: The Wellspring's stone knows your name. On south: Tam waits at the Glass Bridge, past Pilgrim's Ash.

stages.journal:
Tam is waiting for you at the Glass Bridge on the pay's road south, and two grey things have come up from under its arch at him.

They are walking at him the way people walk towards somebody they know. He has not drawn.

Ride on south past Pilgrim's Ash to the Glass Bridge. Put down the two ash-wights on the bridge road, then speak to Tam.

They are ash-wights: the grey that used to be Greyfold's people.

objectives.text: Put down the two ash-wights on the bridge road
Speak to Tam at the bridge's far end

say: Come on. The Stair's past the Choir. She'll want her pay.

stages.journal:
The bridge road is clear, and the Warden at the Stair Head is still a month short of her pay: put it in her hands.

Tam read his letter again at the bridge. Fallowfold, the village he was born in, has been struck from a Roll in Tollmere: written down as a place that never was. He says it does not matter. He said it twice. He wants to get the pay delivered.

Ride on past the Sunken Choir to the Stair Head, the Wardens' camp where the road ends at the top of the Hushline Stair, and give the Warden at her fire her pay.

objectives.text: Give the Warden at the Stair Head her pay

say: Hobb. Hobb! Nobody comes back up!
